about.title: A Neighborhood Burger Bar for Adults
about.subheading: Cold carbon steel, 28-day aged chuck, clarified butter, and zero pretension.
about.storyP1: BUN & PATTY started with a simple conviction: the modern burger scene has become overwhelmed with hollow gimmicks—gold leaf, truffle oil sprays, and towering creations engineered for social media that collapse on the first bite.
about.storyP2: We chose a different path. We took inspiration from historic French plancha cooking, the exacting techniques of traditional Japanese butchery, and the warm hospitality of classic European bistros. Everything starts with whole-muscle beef cuts, ground fresh each morning.
about.storyP3: Our signature potato-milk brioche buns are slow-fermented for 18 hours to achieve structural integrity, and our sauces are cooked in small batches without artificial thickeners. It is uncompromised craft, served simply.
about.pillar1Desc: Paper-thin smash technique creating maximized Maillard crust and juicy lacy edges within 15 seconds.
about.pillar2Desc: Aged chuck, brisket, and short rib freshly ground twice daily with an unyielding 80/20 fat ratio.
about.pillar3Desc: Formulated with pasture eggs and cultured European butter to cradle rich savory jus without ever turning soggy.

locations.subtitle: Each outpost features our signature 260°C plancha, counter pickup, and direct courier dispatch across Tbilisi.

bun-patty-smash.name: Bun & Patty Signature Burger
bun-patty-smash.description: Two smashed 90 g beef patties with melted American cheese, two fried eggs, crispy bacon, pickles, and house special sauce on a brioche bun.
bun-patty-smash.longDescription: Our house signature, built tall and messy. Two 90 g beef patties smashed on 260°C carbon steel and blanketed in melted American cheese, stacked with two runny fried eggs, crispy smoked bacon, pickles, and our house special sauce on a butter-toasted brioche bun.

golden-double-classic.name: Classic Double Cheeseburger
golden-double-classic.description: Two smashed 90 g beef patties, double aged cheddar, pickled cucumber, shaved sweet onion, and house special sauce.
golden-double-classic.longDescription: The purist standard prepared with absolute plancha discipline. Two 90 g beef patties smashed thin for caramelized lace edges, paired with double melted cheddar, thinly shaved sweet onion, crisp pickled cucumbers, and our house special sauce on a toasted milk bun.

truffle-forest-melt.name: Truffle Forest Melt
truffle-forest-melt.description: Double 90 g smashed patties, sautéed brown beech mushrooms, melted Swiss Gruyère, and black truffle aioli on brioche.
truffle-forest-melt.longDescription: An intensely savory forest-inspired creation featuring two 90 g dry-aged beef patties. Smothered in butter-sautéed brown beech mushrooms, nutty aged Swiss Gruyère, and fragrant black truffle emulsion on our signature griddled brioche bun.

sweet-heat-jalapeno.name: Sweet Heat Pickled Jalapeño
sweet-heat-jalapeno.description: Double 90 g smashed patties, pepper jack cheese, quick-pickled jalapeño rings, wildflower hot honey, and crispy fried shallots.
sweet-heat-jalapeno.longDescription: A vibrant balance of tongue-tingling spice and floral warmth. Two 90 g smashed beef patties capped with molten pepper jack cheese, house-pickled green jalapeño rings, crispy fried shallots, and a drizzle of local wildflower honey infused with dried red chilies.

buttermilk-crispy-chicken.name: Buttermilk Fried Chicken Sandwich
buttermilk-crispy-chicken.description: 24-hour buttermilk soaked chicken thigh, triple-dredged crisp crust, cabbage-apple slaw, and smoked garlic emulsion on sesame brioche.
buttermilk-crispy-chicken.longDescription: Juicy boneless chicken thigh marinated for 24 hours in cultured buttermilk and herbs, dredged in seasoned flour for shatteringly crisp crunch. Paired with tangy shaved cabbage and green apple slaw and smoked garlic aioli on a toasted sesame brioche bun.

crispy-halloumi-mint.name: Mozzarella Burger
crispy-halloumi-mint.description: Fried mozzarella, cheddar, cheese sauce, house special sauce, iceberg lettuce, and tomato on a toasted burger bun.
crispy-halloumi-mint.longDescription: A meat-free burger built around a thick, golden fried mozzarella patty with a crisp crumb and a molten, stretchy centre. Layered with melted cheddar, warm cheese sauce, our house special sauce, crunchy iceberg lettuce, and fresh tomato on a toasted burger bun.

double-smashed-bacon-burger.name: Double Smashed Bacon Burger
double-smashed-bacon-burger.description: Two smashed beef patties, 90 g each, with crispy bacon, melted cheddar, pickled cucumber, onion, burger sauce, and a toasted brioche bun.
double-smashed-bacon-burger.longDescription: Two fresh 90 g beef patties smashed searing-hot on 260°C carbon steel to lock in juices and create signature caramelized lacy edges. Topped with thick strips of crispy smoked bacon, rich melted cheddar cheese, house pickled cucumber rounds, sweet shaved onion, and creamy burger sauce on a butter-griddled potato brioche bun.

the-big-one.name: The Big One
the-big-one.description: 750 g of beef, 6 layers of cheddar, 2 layers of bacon, special sauce, onion in Saperavi wine, iceberg, and pickled cucumber.
the-big-one.longDescription: Our towering culinary centerpiece built for serious burger enthusiasts and communal sharing. Features an extraordinary 750 g of dry-aged beef smashed paper-thin across juicy tiers, interlaced with six generous blankets of melted sharp cheddar, two ribbons of crispy smoked bacon, and sweet red onions marinated in Kakheti Saperavi wine. Balanced with crunchy iceberg lettuce, vinegar pickled cucumber, and house special burger sauce on an oversized toasted sesame bun secured by twin skewers.
the-big-one.allergens: Gluten, Dairy, Eggs, Mustard, Sulphites (Saperavi wine marinade) [Placeholder]

golden-crinkle-fries.name: Fries
golden-crinkle-fries.description: Thick-cut crinkle potatoes double-fried in clean oil, tossed in pulverized sea salt, fresh rosemary, and lemon thyme.
golden-crinkle-fries.longDescription: We double-fry thick russet potatoes to guarantee a crunchy exterior ridges and a fluffy baked potato interior. Straight from the fryer, they are tossed with pulverized sea salt crystals, fresh fragrant rosemary, and lemon thyme.

parmesan-truffle-fries.name: Truffle Fries
parmesan-truffle-fries.description: Skin-on hand-cut fries drizzled with white truffle oil, dusted with 24-month aged parmesan, and cracked Tellicherry black pepper.
parmesan-truffle-fries.longDescription: Hand-cut russet fries cooked until dark golden and immediately tossed with Italian white truffle oil, a generous snowfall of aged Parmigiano-Reggiano, and freshly cracked black peppercorns.

onion-rings.name: Onion Rings
onion-rings.description: Thick rings of sweet onion soaked in buttermilk, coated in seasoned Japanese panko, and fried to golden perfection.
onion-rings.longDescription: Thick-cut sweet onion rings soaked in seasoned cultured buttermilk and dredged in coarse Japanese panko breadcrumbs. Fried to a resonant, shatter-crisp crunch with a sweet, tender interior.

fries-with-cheese-and-bacon.name: Fries with Cheese and Bacon
fries-with-cheese-and-bacon.description: Crispy golden fries smothered in thick, glossy melted cheese sauce and crispy bacon pieces.
fries-with-cheese-and-bacon.longDescription: A generous mountain of hand-cut double-fried golden potatoes, heavily blanketed in rich, velvety molten cheddar cheese sauce cascading through the entire portion, crowned with abundant crispy smoked bacon pieces and freshly snipped scallions.

caesar-salad.name: Caesar Salad
caesar-salad.description: Romaine lettuce, grilled chicken, parmesan, croutons, and Caesar dressing.
caesar-salad.longDescription: Crisp cold romaine hearts chopped fresh to order and lightly coated in creamy garlic-parmesan Caesar dressing. Crowned with tender slices of plancha-grilled chicken breast, aged shaved parmesan curls, and crunchy golden brioche garlic croutons.

bowl-mix.name: Bowl Mix
bowl-mix.description: A loaded bowl of crispy fries topped with a chopped 90 g smashed beef patty, crispy bacon, shredded iceberg, hot cheese sauce, BBQ sauce, and grated parmesan.
bowl-mix.longDescription: Our loaded plancha comfort bowl: a generous base of hot, crispy golden fries topped with a freshly chopped 90 g smashed beef patty, crispy smoked bacon pieces, shredded crunchy iceberg lettuce, hot cheddar cheese sauce, smoky BBQ sauce, and a dusting of grated parmesan.

chicken-wings.name: Chicken Wings
chicken-wings.description: 8 crispy chicken wings tossed in your choice of spicy or BBQ glaze, served with a dipping sauce.
chicken-wings.longDescription: Eight juicy chicken wings, lightly dusted in seasoned flour and fried until crackling-crisp, then tossed in your choice of glaze: a fiery butter-chili Spicy or a sticky, smoky BBQ. Served with a cool, creamy garlic-herb dipping sauce.

smoky-bourbon-bacon-jam.name: Smoky Bourbon Bacon Jam
smoky-bourbon-bacon-jam.description: House-made savory jam of slow-cooked caramelized onions, smoked bacon, bourbon, shallots, and dark molasses.
smoky-bourbon-bacon-jam.longDescription: Our signature condiment cooked low and slow for six hours. Caramelized onions break down with shallots, diced smoked bacon, and a splash of bourbon into an amber, deeply savory spread.

sauce-truffle-aioli.name: Black Truffle Aioli
sauce-truffle-aioli.description: Emulsified cold-pressed olive oil, roasted garlic, minced black summer truffles, and fresh garden chives.
sauce-truffle-aioli.longDescription: A silky, luxurious dipping emulsion whisked with roasted garlic cloves, fragrant black summer truffles, organic egg yolks, and fresh snipped chives.

sauce-house-secret.name: House Special Sauce
sauce-house-secret.description: Our proprietary blend of kewpie mayonnaise, coarse whole grain mustard, brine-pickled capers, and sweet relish.
sauce-house-secret.longDescription: The savory backbone of our classic cheeseburgers. Prepared daily with rich mayonnaise, crushed capers, tangy pickle relish, and a house blend of ground roasted spices.

cheese-injection.name: Cheese Injection
cheese-injection.description: A food-safe, reusable stainless steel culinary injector filled with hot cheese sauce, ready to inject straight into your burger.
cheese-injection.longDescription: An interactive treat for true cheese lovers. A food-safe, reusable stainless steel kitchen injector with a three-ring plunger and a long injection needle, filled with 60 ml of piping hot, velvety melted cheddar sauce ready to inject directly into the center of your burger.

cheese-sauce.name: Cheese Sauce
cheese-sauce.description: A small cup of smooth, hot cheddar cheese sauce for dipping.
cheese-sauce.longDescription: A small cup of smooth, velvety hot cheddar cheese sauce, made for dipping fries, onion rings, or the crispy edges of your burger.

ketchup.name: Ketchup
ketchup.description: A small cup of classic tomato ketchup.
ketchup.longDescription: A small cup of classic, rich tomato ketchup — sweet, tangy, and made for fries, onion rings, and wings.

warm-bourbon-caramel-brownie.name: Skillet Dark Chocolate Brownie
warm-bourbon-caramel-brownie.description: 70% dark chocolate brownie with warm bourbon caramel center and sea salt crystals.
warm-bourbon-caramel-brownie.longDescription: Baked in an individual cast-iron skillet to order. Crisp candy crust on the outside with a molten fudge core, drizzled with bourbon caramel and coarse sea salt flakes.

lava-cake.name: Lava Cake
lava-cake.description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten center.
lava-cake.longDescription: An indulgent, freshly baked individual dark chocolate cake featuring a crisp delicate exterior crust that releases a warm, flowing river of molten dark chocolate upon first incision. Lightly dusted with premium Dutch cocoa powder and served warm.

cheesecake.name: Basque Cheesecake
cheesecake.description: Caramelized burnt Basque cheesecake with a molten creamy center on parchment paper.
cheesecake.longDescription: Baked at high heat to achieve a deeply caramelized, dark burnished top while preserving an ultra-creamy, custard-like soft center. Served rustic on crumpled baking parchment with a touch of vanilla.

cold-steeped-lemon-ceylon-tea.name: Tea
cold-steeped-lemon-ceylon-tea.description: 18-hour cold brew Ceylon black tea, fresh lemon juice, and crushed lemon thyme over hand-cut ice.
cold-steeped-lemon-ceylon-tea.longDescription: We steep high-grown single-origin Ceylon black tea leaves in cold filtered water for 18 hours to extract clean floral tannins without bitterness. Shaken with fresh lemon juice and a touch of honey, then poured over hand-cut ice with fresh lemon thyme.

roasted-vanilla-bean-shake.name: Shake
roasted-vanilla-bean-shake.description: Hand-spun local frozen dairy custard, whole scraped Madagascar vanilla bean, and whipped cultured cream.
roasted-vanilla-bean-shake.longDescription: Traditional dense frozen custard churned fresh every morning with rich whole dairy milk and egg yolks. Hand-spun on vintage spindle mixers with scraped Madagascar vanilla caviar and topped with cultured whipped cream.

pepsi-can.name: Pepsi
pepsi-can.longDescription: Ice-cold 330 ml aluminium can of classic Pepsi cola, served chilled from our beverage coolers. Served upon request with a heavy glass tumbler filled with crystal-clear ice cubes and a fresh slice of lemon.

coca-cola.name: Coca-Cola
coca-cola.longDescription: Ice-cold 330 ml can of classic Coca-Cola, served chilled from our beverage coolers. Served upon request with a glass tumbler filled with crystal-clear ice cubes and a fresh slice of lemon.

water.name: Water
water.longDescription: Pure refreshing natural mineral water in a 500 ml glass bottle. Required choice of still or sparkling, served chilled.

natural-juice.name: Natural Juice
natural-juice.description: 300 ml glass of freshly squeezed natural juice, with no added sugar.
natural-juice.longDescription: 300 ml glass of freshly squeezed natural juice, with no added sugar. Prepared fresh to order from seasonal fruit. Choose your favorite flavor: orange, apple, pomegranate, pineapple, cherry, or a non-alcoholic mojito blend of fresh lime and mint.

pepsi-zero-sugar.name: Pepsi Zero Sugar
pepsi-zero-sugar.longDescription: Ice-cold 330 ml can of Pepsi Zero Sugar, served chilled from our beverage coolers. Served upon request with a glass tumbler of ice and a fresh slice of lemon.

coca-cola-zero-sugar.name: Coca-Cola Zero Sugar
coca-cola-zero-sugar.longDescription: Ice-cold 330 ml can of Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, served chilled from our beverage coolers. Served upon request with a glass tumbler of ice and a fresh slice of lemon.

espresso.name: Espresso
espresso.description: A single shot of rich espresso.
espresso.longDescription: A single shot of rich, freshly pulled specialty espresso with a thick golden crema and balanced chocolate-caramel notes.

americano.name: Americano
americano.longDescription: Freshly pulled espresso lengthened with hot filtered water for a clean, aromatic cup of coffee.

cappuccino.name: Cappuccino
cappuccino.description: Espresso with steamed milk and thick milk foam.
cappuccino.longDescription: Rich espresso topped with sweet steamed whole milk and a thick, silky layer of milk foam.

latte.name: Latte
latte.description: Espresso with plenty of steamed milk and a thin layer of foam.
latte.longDescription: Smooth espresso with a generous pour of silky steamed whole milk, finished with a thin layer of milk foam.

iced-coffee.name: Iced Coffee
iced-coffee.description: Chilled espresso with milk over ice.
iced-coffee.longDescription: Freshly pulled espresso, chilled and poured over ice with cold whole milk.

glace.name: Iced Coffee with Ice Cream
glace.description: Chilled coffee topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.
glace.longDescription: Chilled freshly brewed coffee topped with a generous scoop of vanilla ice cream that slowly melts into the glass.
